senses.en: unwise, without good sense
examples: It would be [[foolish]] to spend money on something you can't afford.

senses.zh: （尤指两条道路的）交叉点，十字路口；（线的）交叉点
senses.en: a place where roads, lines, etc. cross each other, esp. where two roads meet
examples: Traffic lights have been placed at all major [[intersections]].

senses.en: (fml.) meet sb. without planning to
examples: I first [[encountered]] him when I was studying at Cambridge.

senses.zh: 遇到，遭遇（尤指问题或反对）
senses.en: experience sth., esp. problems or opposition
examples: The more dangers we [[encounter]], the harder should we push forward.

senses.zh: （尤指因看起来费劲而）凝视，盯着看
senses.en: look very carefully or hard at sth., esp. because you are having difficulty seeing it
examples: I had been [[peering]] at a computer printout that made no sense at all.

senses.zh: 同龄人；身份（或地位）相同的人
senses.en: (fml.) sb. of the same age, social class, etc.
examples: Children compete to win the approval of their [[peers]].

senses.en: (esp. AmE) moving or pointing toward a higher position
examples: Pointing [[upward]], he indicated a large nest high in the tree.

senses.en: a small room where you can leave your coat
a group of animals of one kind that live and feed together
examples: The milkman selected the spotted cows, from among a [[herd]] of 200.

senses.en: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know sth., which is not learned
examples: Hearing the loud noise, Mary's first [[instinct]] was to hide under the blankets.

senses.zh: 群体本能（人或动物在行为或思维上从众的自然趋势）
senses.en: the natural tendency in people or animals to behave or think like other people or animals
control or influence sth.
examples: Circumstances [[dictated]] that they played a defensive rather than attacking game.

senses.en: say words for sb. else to write down
examples: She's [[dictating]] a letter to her secretary right now.

senses.en: a force that causes bad things to happen
examples: There's always a conflict between good and [[evil]] in his plays.

senses.en: (esp. AmE) a share in a company
a supply of a particular type of thing that a shop has available to sell
examples: We have a huge [[stock]] of quality carpets on sale.

senses.zh: 证券交易（所）；股票交易（所）；股市
senses.en: the business of buying and selling shares in companies and the place where this happens

senses.zh: 人心惶惶的局面；惶恐不安
senses.en: a situation in which people are suddenly made very anxious, and make quick decisions without thinking carefully
examples: The magazine article is about the recent [[panic]] over the safety of baby milk.

senses.en: an overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety
examples: The audience were thrown into a [[panic]] when the fire started.

senses.en: the belief in the existence of a god or gods, and the activities that are connected with the worship of them
examples: Try to avoid as much as possible subjects such as [[religion]], sex, or politics.

senses.en: make sth. unable to operate normally
examples: The regional capital was [[paralyzed]] by a general strike.

senses.en: make sb. lose the ability to move part or all of their body, or to feel it
examples: Her legs were partly [[paralyzed]] in the crash.

senses.zh: 非常有名的；大名鼎鼎的；传奇式的
senses.en: very famous and admired
examples: He is [[legendary]] for his fearlessness and determination.

senses.en: a scientist trained in psychology
examples: [[Psychologist]] Martin Lloyd-Elliott is also a best-selling author.

senses.en: influence sb. so that they begin to behave in an unacceptable or shocking way
examples: I never had any toys since my father thought that they would [[warp]] my personal values.

senses.en: become, or make sth. become, twisted or bent out of its natural shape, for example because it has become too hot, too damp, etc.
examples: The window frame must have been [[warped]]; it won't close properly.

senses.en: (~ to / with) be the same as or match sth.
examples: Your account of the event does not [[correspond]] with hers.

senses.en: the state of continuing to live or exist
examples: The man's [[survival]] was surprising, as the doctors thought he would die.

senses.zh: 采猎者（以打猎和采集植物为生的人）
senses.en: a member of a group of people that lives by hunting and looking for plants that can be eaten, rather than by keeping animals for food or by growing crops
suddenly run somewhere very quickly, esp. in order to escape or because you are frightened
examples: The thief [[bolted]] when he saw the policeman.

senses.en: rub your fingernails against your skin
examples: Jessica lifted her sunglasses and [[scratched]] her nose.

senses.en: run very fast for a short distance
examples: I saw Charlie [[sprinting]] through the traffic toward me.

senses.en: a part of a cell in a living thing which controls its physical characteristics, growth, and development
examples: He said he was good at sports because he had the athletic [[gene]].

senses.en: sb. who is related to a person who lived a long time ago, or to a family, group of people, etc. that existed in the past
examples: They are [[descendants]] of the original English and Scottish settlers.

senses.en: firmly fixed and unchangeable
examples: The report suggests that deeply [[rooted]] cultural and social factors play a role in these behaviors.

senses.en: (of things or people) making a strong impression, because they are very large, good, skillful, etc.
examples: The building looked as [[impressive]] in reality as it did in photographs.

senses.en: belonging to or connected with the National Socialist German Workers' Party which controlled Germany from 1933 to 1945

senses.zh: （政府或政党为了影响民意而进行的）宣传
senses.en: information which is false or which emphasizes just one part of a situation, used by a government or political group to make people agree with them
examples: These reports clearly contain elements of [[propaganda]].

senses.en: thorough and complete
examples: The Football League has announced its proposals for a [[radical]] reform of the way football is run in England.

senses.en: shout sth. in a deep powerful voice
examples: It was such a great performance that the audience [[roared]] with appreciation.

senses.en: make a deep, very loud noise
examples: We were so afraid as we heard a lion [[roar]].

senses.zh: 以匿名的方式；不透露姓名地
senses.en: namelessly; without giving a name
examples: The latest photographs were sent [[anonymously]] to the magazine's Paris headquarters.

senses.en: (~ to) give your permission for sth., or agree to do sth.
examples: She asked her mother whether she would [[consent]] to a small celebration after her graduation.

senses.en: the activity or business of drawing public attention to goods and services on television, in newspapers, etc.
examples: The [[advertising]] campaign is aimed primarily at young people.

senses.en: sth. that causes problems and tends to stop sb. / sth. from succeeding or making progress
examples: You have to balance the advantages of living downtown against the [[disadvantages]].

senses.en: (BrE sceptical) having doubts that a claim or statement is true or that sth. will happen
examples: They are [[skeptical]] about my chances of winning.

senses.en: a person who writes novels
examples: Mark Twain has been regarded as the greatest American [[novelist]] of his generation.

senses.en: (BrE transport) a system for moving people from place to place
examples: The president wants to improve the nation's highway and mass [[transit]] system.

senses.en: the process of moving goods or people from one place to another
examples: They promised that my baggage would not be damaged in [[transit]].

senses.en: change sth. into a different form, or change sth. so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way
examples: This device can be used to [[convert]] a signal into a digital code.

senses.en: the first design of sth. from which other forms are copied or developed
examples: We plan to release a [[prototype]] this autumn for trial in hospitals.

senses.en: (input, input; inputted, inputted) put information into a computer
examples: All call center staff do is [[input]] data into computers and so it makes every sense that you do it yourself to cut cost.

senses.en: (only before noun) found or used now
examples: Under [[existing]] regulations, you are not allowed to bring animals into the country.

senses.en: relating to or done using the Web (the system of connected documents on the Internet)
examples: With the new [[web-based]] software, creating a purchase order should take just a few minutes.

senses.en: a system of words, letters, numbers, or symbols that represent a message or record information secretly or in a shorter form
examples: He received a message written in [[code]] yesterday and he didn't know what to do about it.

senses.en: (only before noun) connected with a large or capital city
examples: This is an issue that should be decided by local and [[metropolitan]] governments.

senses.en: (only before noun) of or being the very rapid use, handling, or showing of information by a computer
examples: We are designing a secure and [[real-time]] voice transmission system.

senses.en: used in the names of streets in a town or city
examples: When we visited New York, we stayed in a hotel on Fifth [[Avenue]].

senses.zh: 有效的；产生预期效果的
senses.en: successful, and working in the way that was intended
examples: The cheaper drugs are just as [[effective]] in treating this disease.

senses.en: think or guess that sth. is smaller, cheaper, easier, etc. than it really is
examples: None of us should ever [[underestimate]] the degree of difficulty women face in career advancement.

senses.en: a moment when you suddenly realize or understand sth. important
examples: People are all familiar with the story of Issac Newton's [[epiphany]] about gravity (地球引力) and a falling apple.

senses.en: (only before noun) becoming old; rather old
examples: We need to replace some of the [[aging]] office equipment.

senses.zh: 躲避风雨的地方；避难处
senses.en: a building or an area with a roof over it that protects you from the weather or from danger
examples: They built a rough [[shelter]] from old pieces of wood.

senses.en: a place to live, considered as one of the basic needs of life
examples: They were in need of food and [[shelter]] after the earthquake.

senses.en: (BrE) a small structure with a roof where you wait for a bus
powered by energy from sunlight
examples: The company is developing a fully [[solar-powered]] car.

senses.en: (only before noun) relating to a town or city
examples: The president's visit was the most important [[civic]] event of the year.

senses.en: (fml.) make sth. less severe or extreme
examples: The heat in this coastal town is [[tempered]] by the cool sea breeze (微风).

senses.en: put a piece of equipment somewhere and connect it so that it is ready to be used
examples: It would cost about £3,000 to [[install]] a new heating system in a flat such as theirs.

senses.en: the journey to work every day
examples: I want to rent an apartment near my office because my daily [[commute]] takes too long.

senses.en: the head of the government of a town or city, etc., elected by the public
examples: The crowd gathered in the town square to hear the [[mayor]] speak.

senses.zh: 不确定的；没把握的；拿不准的
senses.en: (not before noun) feeling doubt about sth.
examples: It's still [[uncertain]] whether the College Spring Sports will be held this year.

senses.en: positive and making you feel that good things will happen
examples: New research shows that all it may take to avoid this common disease is a positive and [[upbeat]] attitude.

senses.en: on the way
examples: We stopped for a picnic [[en route]].

senses.zh: （尤指很好或很坏的）行为，行动
senses.en: (fml.) sth. sb. does, esp. sth. that is very good or very bad
examples: His heroic [[deeds]] were celebrated in every corner of the city.

senses.en: cause sth. to start or develop, esp. suddenly
examples: Will the rapid rise in oil prices [[spark]] another crisis?

senses.en: take part in an activity with other people
examples: Now and again he'd [[join in]] when we were playing video games.

senses.zh: 换言之；换句话说；也就是说
senses.en: used to introduce an explanation of sth.
examples: [[In other words]], we have to build different ways of working.

senses.en: used to talk about a series of similar things or events that are done or happening with very little time between them
examples: [[One after another]], people described how hard it was for them to get medical care.

senses.en: stay in the original place
examples: Nigel says for the moment he is very happy to [[stay put]] in London.

senses.en: consider sth. carefully so that you can make a decision about it
examples: You have to [[weigh up]] in your mind whether to pursue your goal or not.

senses.en: at a time in the future
examples: I hate to rush you but I have another appointment [[later on]].

senses.en: become even more unpleasant, difficult, etc.
examples: For the past couple of years my health has [[gone from bad to worse]].

english: make a / no / some / etc. difference

senses.zh: 有（或没有、有些等）作用，关系，影响
senses.en: have an effect / no effect on sb. / sth.
examples: The new central heating has [[made]] an enormous [[difference]] to the house.

senses.en: operating normally
examples: We're trying to get the medical facilities [[up and running]] again.

senses.en: telephone a radio or television program with a comment or question
examples: It's a hot topic, and people have been [[calling in]] all morning.

senses.en: make sure that sth. is actually true, correct, or acceptable
examples: Maybe we ought to go down to the library and [[check]] it [[out]].

senses.en: pull or knock down a building, wall, etc.
examples: The city government has decided to [[tear down]] several buildings and create a park.

senses.zh: 某人忍不住做某事；某人不能停止做某事
senses.en: (also 'sb. can't help but do sth.') used to say that sb. is unable to change their behavior, or feelings, or to prevent themselves from doing sth.
examples: In fact, I [[can't help]] wondering what someone with your experience is doing in a place like this.

senses.zh: 认定某人/某事无用（不重要，失败）
senses.en: decide that sb. / sth. is useless, unimportant, or a failure
examples: It's too soon to [[write off]] the project as a failure.

senses.en: drive to the side of the road and stop your car, bike, etc. or make sb. else do this
examples: The police signaled to him to [[pull over]] and gave him a drunk driving test.

senses.zh: 所罗门 • 阿希（美国社会心理学家）
（非洲）塞伦盖蒂（联合国教科文组织‘人与生物圈计划’的生物圈保护区）
约瑟夫 • 戈培尔（纳粹德国宣传部长）
W. 萨默塞特 • 毛姆（英国著名小说家）
曼哈顿（美国纽约市一个行政区，纽约市的商业和文化中心）
美国加利福尼亚州的一家科技公司
门洛帕克（美国加利福尼亚州城市）
